meaning_disclaimer: UNKNOWN/NO_LANDMARK means insufficient reference structure only. It does NOT mean dangerous, unsafe, unstable, or wrong.

totals.reason_outside_pool: MR01/MR02: n_steps=3<4, structurally cannot be z-scored (unchanged since reports/multi-tensor-atlas-v0). FG02: n_steps=6, was scored across all 24 layers in the original V0 sweep, produced zero qualifying spikes at any layer, not only the 4 confirmed ones.

routes_with_no_confirmed_landmark.note: 3 of these 12 (FG01, all seeds) ARE in the eligible pool and WERE scored -- they simply never produced a qualifying spike at any of the 4 confirmed layers. This is a genuine null result for FG01, not a scoring gap.

runs_with_partial_landmark_coverage.the_one_full_coverage_run: KVC_AH02_1102, route L0-L5-L1-L20-L5 -- the single most complete observed route in the corpus, from one AMBIGUITY_HANDLING seed
runs_with_partial_landmark_coverage.note: Most runs that touch the network at all touch only 1-2 of its 4 nodes -- the network is real but thinly traversed by any single run.

prompt_families_with_zero_route_support.FACTUAL_GROUNDED: 0/6 runs (both FG01 and FG02) show any of the 4 confirmed landmarks, despite FG01 contributing to a different (non-network, RECURRING_BUT_LOW_SUPPORT) candidate at layer 2 in the validated landmark gate
prompt_families_with_zero_route_support.MATH_REASONING: 0/6 runs -- structurally excluded from z-scoring at the candidate-generation stage (n_steps=3)

prompt_families_with_full_route_support.STRUCTURED_OUTPUT: 6/6 runs (all via the single-node L20 route only)

large_step_intervals_without_landmarks: Not separately computed as a dedicated interval-gap statistic in this gate (would require a frozen gap-length threshold not specified in the mission); qualitatively evident from ROUTE_INSTANCES.csv's first/last-encounter-step columns -- e.g. GI01_1102's single L5 encounter is at step 41 of a 48-step run, meaning steps 0-40 and 42-47 contain no confirmed landmark for that run.
